author: Gene Holcombe
text:
Before you start bashing Abbott, have you considered
- compression lows
- Bluetooth signals can intermittently get lost, and then come back on their own.  A good way to come back from that is to rescan your sensor.  That works 99% of the time for me.

These sensors are the best and most accurate on the market.  If you treat time correctly, remember they are medical devices, they will work correctly.
Abbott is cracking down on replacements.  If you request too many, they will start limiting replacement sensors.  That's just not the right thing to do as first line of defense.  Learn how to use the sensor correctly and it will work properly

author: Joe Paddington
text:
I have the same problem.  Abbot told me not to update my phone because the sensors aren’t designed to handle IOS beyond IOS 17!!!
Complete und utter BS.  It’s just fawlty sensors.  Of a pack of eight sensors normally I get between 2 to 4 that fail.  
Fortunately Abbot replaces them quickly.
